name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle designed to travel on no more than three wheels; an electric two-wheeler whose motor exceeds a motorscooter's 5,000 watts, or that is heavier, longer or geared beyond one, is a full motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its electric motor exceeds 5,000 watts, or it exceeds a motorscooter's 450-pound dry weight or 64-inch wheelbase or has a manual transmission
Riders need a Class M license, from 16; a motorcycle learner permit is available at 15, limited to 650 cc, 4 a.m. to 8 p.m., within seven miles of home, no passengers and no interstates
Completing a Tennessee Motorcycle Rider Education Program course waives the knowledge and skills tests
Riders and passengers must wear a crash helmet, one meeting FMVSS 218 if under 21
Titled and registered as a motor vehicle
The motorized bicycle category is framed by a 50 cc cylinder capacity, so an electric moped-class vehicle is a motorscooter rather than a motorized bicycle
One designed primarily for off-highway use, such as a dirt bike, is an off-highway motor vehicle instead
